notes:
Summary: NeedlePoint is an adtech DSP focusing on sub-50ms p95 decisioning for programmatic bids. Very cost sensitive for high qps workloads; wants to balance latency and per-request cost. Interested in Redwood Dedicated + Optimize to tune batching/caching/quantization.

Key technical asks / quotes: 
- CTO (R. Alvarez): "If p95 creeps above 40ms we lose win-rate; need deterministic tail behavior."
- Wants concrete perf numbers: p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, and cost-per-1M-requests estimates.

Performance targets and constraints: 
- Target p95 end-to-end < 40ms for short prompts (avg 20 tokens).
- Peak throughput target: 3k-5k QPS for scoring + reranking flows; sustained bursts to 8k QPS for flash auctions.
- Cost target: keep marginal cost per decision below $0.0005 - $0.001.

Model / runtime preferences: 
- Prefer tuned open models (Llama family variants) quantized to int8/int4 for cost and cache friendliness.
- Wants model pinning for consistent A/B experiments and rollouts.
- Need quick fallback route to smaller model when Dedicated pool saturated.

Optimize interest (explicit asks): 
- Batching: recommended max batching latency bucketing (e.g., small-window continuous batching) and optimal batch sizes for p95 tradeoffs.
- Caching: prefix and KV caching for common ad-templates; want configurable TTLs and cache hit metrics at token and request level.
- Quantization: recommendations on int8 vs int4 for chosen model family; end-to-end quality regression threshold (acceptable ROUGE/accuracy delta).
- Perf benchmarking: run Redwood-provided harness against their traffic traces (synthetic replay + real traces), include network hop simulation for EU traffic.

POC plan: 
- Week 0: share sample production traces + secretless prompt corpus.
- Week 1: Redwood runs dedicated pool baseline with unquantized model, captures p50/p95/p99 and cost metrics.
- Week 2: Apply batching/caching configs + int8 quantization; measure delta in latency and cost.
- Week 3: Stress test bursts (8k QPS) and run fallbacks; produce final report and recommended config.

Open items / blockers: 
- SOC2 evidence pack and security questionnaire needs to be completed before procurement can issue PO.
- Clarify EU data residency path (they want EU traffic served from EU-only cluster).
- Procurement hit: need finance to agree to monthly commit for Dedicated nodes, else prefer hosted with burst option.

Communication notes: 
- Timeline is tight; needlepoint expects a decision by 2026-04 to align with Q2 campaign commitments.
- Customer appreciates concrete benchmark artifacts (CSV/JSON) and an automated eval harness they can run locally.
